entities.summary: BD−08°2823 c is an extrasolar planet which orbits the K-type main sequence star BD−08°2823, located approximately 135 light years away in the constellation Sextans. This planet has at least one-thirds the mass of Jupiter and takes 7.8 months to orbit the star at a semimajor axis of 0.68 AU. This planet was detected by HARPS on October 19, 2009, together with 29 other planets, including BD−08°2823 b.
